text: Safety regression found an issue in the new collision sensitivity setting at the highest level: the protective stop takes 310 ms instead of the required 250 ms.
Confirmed. Fix is small but needs a full re-test. Firmware 4.0 release moves to 9 December.
<@U03SOFIA> should I tell the customers who asked about 4.0?
Yes please, 9 December, and no change for anyone not using the highest sensitivity level.
